entry.alt: The current Compare first-shipment arrangements case opens with its decision question, workspace layouts and supplied fictional inputs.
entry.caption: Open the pinned shipment workflow with its supplied example, then calculate a fresh finding.

inputs.alt: Forms and the uncalculated Decision summary appear side by side. Calculate sits above the authored Commitment inputs; the supplied case is marked Example data.
inputs.caption: Inspect the shipment identity, quantity and timing before calculating. An uncalculated case is not a failed shipment.

arrangements.alt: The Options section shows Backup preferred at $6,000 and Direct blocked at $4,000, with the unresolved registration condition and stated cost-first comparison priority.
arrangements.caption: Read Options for the supported arrangement and the condition affecting the cheaper alternative. A portal listing alone does not establish transportation registration.

hero.alt: Decision Lab’s current Options summary compares Direct and Backup, showing the cost-first finding, complete expense and registration limit.
hero.caption: A fictional shipment analysis in Decision Lab.

actions.alt: Next actions separates the available shipment response from the option to compare timely verification. Inspecting an action does not purchase verification or reserve freight.
actions.caption: Use Next actions to identify the available response; booking and verification purchase remain operating actions.

assumptions.alt: Assumptions states the modeled shipment scope and limits behind the current finding.
assumptions.caption: The supported result retains the scope and assumptions that make the comparison meaningful.

questions.alt: Questions identifies unresolved matters relevant to the shipment decision.
questions.caption: Keep unresolved questions visible when deciding what to verify before committing.

requirements.alt: Arrangement choice inspects Direct and shows the unmet transportation-registration condition, complete expense and shipment basis.
requirements.caption: Inspect the requirement behind Direct’s blocked finding. Opening supporting detail does not change the inputs or choose the arrangement.

verification.alt: Further verification compares reserving now with fast and slow checks. The $200 fast check supports a $5,200 expected total expense under the supplied hypothetical probabilities and likelihood assumptions.
verification.caption: A timely $200 check gives a $5,200 expected total under the supplied assumptions. This is a contingent comparison; it records no purchased check or freight booking.

process.alt: The current shipment graph connects scoped registration evidence, complete shipment arrangements and timely-verification value. Highlighted paths apply now; dashed paths return to reassessment.
process.caption: Follow the connected questions and labeled paths. Several actions can be available together; inspecting a path does not perform it.

processDetail.alt: Inspecting whether any complete arrangement meets the requirements shows the current answer, its basis, outgoing paths, relevant inputs and supporting reports.
processDetail.caption: Inspect a question to see what supports its answer. This does not select a shipment, obtain permission or reserve freight.

status.alt: Calculation dependencies shows how scoped evidence, current arrangements, report-contingent responses and verification value supply one another.
status.caption: Inspect the calculation handoffs separately from the business decision process.

stale.alt: Applying a change from 100 to 101 cases withdraws the current arrangement comparison and marks the dependent findings stale.
stale.caption: Applied edits invalidate dependent findings. Recalculate the changed shipment before relying on an arrangement.
